facts.text: Conception Seminary College is an undergraduate Roman Catholic seminary college authorized to grant Bachelor of Arts degrees in Philosophy as well as Philosophical and Theological Studies.

sources.title: Accreditation - Conception Seminary College
sources.quote: authorized to grant the following degrees and certificates: Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy, Bachelors in Philosophical and Theological Studies and a certificate in Pre-Theological Studies. CSC is dedicated to providing an enriching and rigorous intellectual formation program
